statement.en: AgentCore provides infrastructure for deploying and operating production AI agents across models and frameworks.

statement.en: The page addresses developers moving agents from prototypes into production.

statement.en: The separate Bedrock Agents Classic documentation says it is closed to new customers and directs them to AgentCore.
statement.ru: Документация отдельного Bedrock Agents Classic сообщает о закрытии для новых клиентов и направляет их к AgentCore.
